findings.requirement: All non-PASS reviewer verdicts must block acceptance regardless of board size or majority.
findings.evidence: aggregate_reviews.py:19-27 counts only PASS-like verdicts and accepts when good >= MIN_VALID; with 11 valid reviews, 10 PASS and 1 FAIL/UNKNOWN without findings can produce PASS.
findings.falsifier: A test with 11 valid reviews containing one FAIL or UNKNOWN verdict and no findings must never aggregate to PASS.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Review and audit aggregation verdict handling; require every non-accepting verdict to block or require adjudication.

findings.requirement: UNKNOWN verdicts must remain mandatory blockers even when no UNKNOWN-severity finding is supplied.
findings.evidence: aggregate_reviews.py:18-27 and aggregate_audits.py:20-29 inspect unknown finding counts but do not independently treat verdict == UNKNOWN as blocking; majority masking can therefore erase mandatory UNKNOWN.
findings.falsifier: A quorum-sized payload set containing one valid UNKNOWN verdict with zero findings must aggregate to UNKNOWN or a blocking decision, never PASS.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Make verdict semantics authoritative and fail closed for UNKNOWN, FAIL, REPAIR_REQUIRED, and disagreement states.

findings.requirement: Native validation artifacts must be schema-validated and bound to the exact candidate and validator execution.
findings.evidence: aggregate_reviews.py:11-13 and aggregate_audits.py:11-13 require only key presence plus a few equality checks; arbitrary repository, branch, validator, command, timestamp, and non-boolean/non-integer values are accepted. calibrate_review_audit_board.py:26 fabricates native evidence in memory.
findings.falsifier: Malformed native artifacts with wrong types, unrelated validator/command, or fabricated metadata must be rejected before aggregation.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Add strict native-evidence schema, provenance, executable validator binding, and typed field validation.

findings.requirement: Calibration must exercise all requested negative controls, including invalid enums, majority masking, mandatory UNKNOWN, and insufficient quorum with blocking verdicts.
findings.evidence: calibrate_review_audit_board.py:51-69 tests missing fields, stale SHA, independence, basic quorum, and one-defect aggregates, but does not test invalid enum payloads, verdict-only UNKNOWN/FAIL, majority masking above quorum, or malformed native fields.
findings.falsifier: Calibration must contain deterministic cases for each attack class and fail if any expected blocking decision is bypassed.
findings.recommended_repair_scope: Expand calibration controls and assert fail-closed decisions for every malformed-input and adversarial aggregation scenario.
